warningContent.para: WARNING: Flight data recorders contain flight-critical accident investigation data. Never attempt to erase, modify, or tamper with FDR data.
Unauthorized manipulation of FDR data is prohibited by aviation regulations and may result in criminal prosecution. Only authorized personnel using certified equipment may download FDR data.
Cockpit voice recorder (CVR) data is protected by privacy regulations. Access to CVR recordings is restricted to authorized accident investigators and regulatory authorities.
Unauthorized access, downloading, or dissemination of CVR data may violate privacy laws and aviation security regulations.
Only certified software versions approved by the aircraft manufacturer and regulatory authority may be installed on indicating and recording systems.
Installation of unapproved software may result in system malfunction, loss of certification, and airworthiness violations.
Aircraft data buses (ARINC 429, AFDX) transmit flight-critical information. Do not connect unauthorized devices to aircraft data buses.
Unauthorized data bus connections may introduce malicious code, corrupt flight data, or compromise aircraft cybersecurity (DO-326A / ED-202A requirements).
Use only approved, virus-scanned data transfer devices when loading software or configuration data into avionics systems.
Infected USB drives or laptops may introduce malware into aircraft systems, potentially compromising flight safety and data integrity.
QAR data contains sensitive operational information including flight parameters, crew actions, and aircraft performance data.
Ensure proper data protection measures are in place when transferring QAR data to prevent unauthorized access or data breaches. Follow applicable GDPR and data privacy regulations.
